bg.purpose: Page background and inset control fill.

canvas.purpose: Diagram ground; dotted via Graph Dots.

panel.purpose: Every raised surface: chrome, cards, chips, menus.

ink.purpose: Primary text and the strongest rules (2px in the brief).

accent.purpose: The single accent: selection, links, active states, focus rings, traced paths. One accent for the whole system.

warn.purpose: Warnings, findings, changed deltas, plan banner.

fresh.purpose: Transient just-applied pulse in diagram and banner, both themes.

vpc.purpose: VPC boundary stroke and dotted route lines.

cat-compute.purpose: 1px outline of the node type code, legend dot, cost bar. Identifies; never fills surfaces or runs down an edge.

cat-database.purpose: 1px outline of the node type code, legend dot, cost bar. Identifies; never fills surfaces or runs down an edge.

cat-storage.purpose: 1px outline of the node type code, legend dot, cost bar. Identifies; never fills surfaces or runs down an edge.

cat-network.purpose: 1px outline of the node type code, legend dot, cost bar. Identifies; never fills surfaces or runs down an edge.

cat-integration.purpose: 1px outline of the node type code, legend dot, cost bar. Identifies; never fills surfaces or runs down an edge.

cat-api.purpose: 1px outline of the node type code, legend dot, cost bar. Identifies; never fills surfaces or runs down an edge.

cat-security.purpose: 1px outline of the node type code, legend dot, cost bar. Identifies; never fills surfaces or runs down an edge.

cat-monitoring.purpose: 1px outline of the node type code, legend dot, cost bar. Identifies; never fills surfaces or runs down an edge.

cat-other.purpose: 1px outline of the node type code, legend dot, cost bar. Identifies; never fills surfaces or runs down an edge.

t-com.purpose: HCL syntax color only; fixed on both themes; never reused as UI color.

t-str.purpose: HCL syntax color only; fixed on both themes; never reused as UI color.

t-key.purpose: HCL syntax color only; fixed on both themes; never reused as UI color.

t-ref.purpose: HCL syntax color only; fixed on both themes; never reused as UI color.

t-lit.purpose: HCL syntax color only; fixed on both themes; never reused as UI color.

t-kw.purpose: HCL syntax color only; fixed on both themes; never reused as UI color.

themes.name: dark
themes.trigger: data-theme="dark" on the root, or prefers-color-scheme: dark when unset
themes.description: A re-papering, not a re-design: same structure, hues and spacing; dark warm papers swap in and the accent lightens.

shadows.name: chrome
shadows.purpose: Kept as a token, used only inside the dropdown menu lift. Controls, toolbar chips and diagram nodes are flat.

shadows.name: menu-lift
shadows.purpose: Overlay dropdowns only, layered with chrome. The single sanctioned bigger lift.

shadows.name: state-ring
shadows.purpose: Selected / traced states; replaces rather than stacks with other rings. Status variants mix the status hue at 30-45%.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Color/border/transform responses on buttons, chips, chevrons. States respond; the page never animates for show.

motion.name: pulse-fresh
motion.value: expanding box-shadow ring to 14px, 1.2s ease-out, 3 iterations
motion.purpose: Just-applied breathing of new resources, in Apply Green. Three times, then quiet.

motion.name: trace-dash
motion.value: stroke-dashoffset drift of 14px per 0.9s, linear, infinite
motion.purpose: Active data-flow paths only. Paused under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

motion.name: notice-fade
motion.purpose: The applied banner decays to quiet, because the moment has passed.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Dash animation and pulses stop; state changes stay legible through color and shape.

breakpoints.name: wrap
breakpoints.purpose: Top bar wraps; state file drops to its own row.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Columns stack: diagram first (~62vh), panel below; tabs sticky; minimap and collapse handle removed.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Brief sheet goes edge-to-edge; meta grid drops to two columns.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Three top-bar rows (total, controls, state file); canvas tools become one swipeable row.

components.name: Resource node
components.description: Signature diagram unit: flat 1px paper outline (3px radius, no shadow), a type code outlined in the category hue, label + mono hint, right-aligned tabular cost.
components.css: .ds-node{--ds-cat:var(--cat-compute,#e07b2c);width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 10px 8px 8px;background:var(--panel,#fffefb);color:var(--ink,#1c1d20);border:1px solid var(--line-2,#cfcbbf);border-radius:3px;font-family:Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;transition:border-color .2s}.ds-node:hover{border-color:var(--ink-2,#4a4c52)}.ds-node__tag{min-width:34px;height:24px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:3px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--ds-cat);color:var(--ink,#1c1d20);font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.02em;white-space:nowrap}.ds-node__body{display:grid;min-width:0;line-height:1.25}.ds-node__label{font-weight:600;font-size:12px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-node__hint{font:10px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace;color:var(--ink-3,#85878d);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-node__cost{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}.ds-node__cost i{font-style:normal;color:var(--ink-3,#85878d);margin-right:1px}

components.name: Quiet button
components.description: Standard control: paper fill, hairline contour; hover and attention go to Printing Blue, hover never fills.
components.css: .ds-btn{font:500 12px/1.4 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#1c1d20);background:var(--panel,#fffefb);border:1px solid var(--line-2,#cfcbbf);border-radius:6px;padding:5px 10px;cursor:pointer;transition:color .15s,border-color .15s,background .15s}.ds-btn:hover{color:var(--accent,#1f6feb);border-color:var(--accent,#1f6feb)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#1f6feb);outline-offset:1px}.ds-btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}

components.name: Toolbar chip
components.description: Flat canvas overlay toggle: 1px contour, 3px radius, no shadow; checked state takes the accent border and text.
components.css: .ds-toggle{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font:400 12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#1c1d20);background:var(--panel,#fffefb);border:1px solid var(--line,#e2dfd6);border-radius:3px;padding:4px 8px;cursor:pointer;transition:color .15s,border-color .15s}.ds-toggle:hover,.ds-toggle:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--accent,#1f6feb);color:var(--accent,#1f6feb)}.ds-toggle input{accent-color:var(--accent,#1f6feb)}.ds-toggle input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#1f6feb);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Side-panel navigation: quiet text tabs with a 2px ink underline on the active one, never filled blocks.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:2px;padding:8px 10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e2dfd6);background:var(--panel,#fffefb);font-family:Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif}.ds-tabs__tab{background:none;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;padding:8px 12px;font:500 12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;color:var(--ink-2,#4a4c52);cursor:pointer}.ds-tabs__tab:hover{color:var(--ink,#1c1d20)}.ds-tabs__tab.is-on{color:var(--ink,#1c1d20);border-bottom-color:var(--ink,#1c1d20)}.ds-tabs__tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#1f6feb);outline-offset:-2px}

components.name: IAM / SG chip
components.description: Overlay chips clipped to a node edge strip; hover and open contours go accent.
components.css: .ds-chips{display:inline-flex;gap:3px;align-items:center;padding:1px 3px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid var(--line-2,#cfcbbf);background:var(--panel,#fffefb);font-family:Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;transition:border-color .15s}.ds-chips:hover,.ds-chips.is-open{border-color:var(--accent,#1f6feb)}.ds-chip{font:700 10px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;letter-spacing:.03em;padding:3px 5px;white-space:nowrap}.ds-chip--iam{color:var(--iam,#c4473a);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--iam,#c4473a) 13%,transparent)}.ds-chip--sg{color:var(--sg,#7a5cc7);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--sg,#7a5cc7) 13%,transparent)}.ds-chip__caret{font:600 11px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;color:var(--ink-3,#85878d)}.ds-chips.is-open .ds-chip__caret{color:var(--accent,#1f6feb)}

components.name: Change tag
components.description: Stamped change/state tag: 10px bold caps, 1px outline in the hue with same-hue text, 3px radius; words always ride with color.
components.html: + added ~ changed − removed
components.css: .ds-chg{display:inline-block;font:700 10px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--c);border:1px solid currentColor}

components.name: KPI figure
components.description: Report key figure: caps label, 18px tabular value and caption under a 1px ink rule, like a dimension on a drawing. No tile, no fill.
components.html:
Monthly total

$312.44

144 hrs × $0.0944/hr, always-on
components.css: .ds-kpi{display:grid;align-content:start;gap:4px;padding:10px 0 0;border-top:1px solid var(--ink,#1c1d20);font-family:Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif}.ds-kpi__label{margin:0;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ink-3,#85878d)}.ds-kpi__value{font-size:18px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink,#1c1d20)}.ds-kpi__note{margin:0;font:10px/1.5 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace;color:var(--ink-3,#85878d)}

components.name: Usage slider
components.description: Hand-drawn usage slider: accent fill over a grey track, accent thumb, focus ring; tabular number field nearby.
components.html:
1,000,000req
010M
components.css: .ds-slider{display:grid;gap:4px;max-width:280px;font-family:Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif}.ds-slider__top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink,#1c1d20)}.ds-slider__field{background:var(--bg,#f4f2ec);border:1px solid var(--line,#e2dfd6);border-radius:4px;padding:2px 6px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-slider__unit{font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-3,#85878d)}.ds-slider input[type='range']{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;width:100%;height:16px;margin:0;background:transparent;cursor:pointer}.ds-slider input[type='range']::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{height:4px;border:0;border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--accent,#1f6feb) var(--fill,60%),color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink-3,#85878d) 30%,transparent) var(--fill,60%))}.ds-slider input[type='range']::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:14px;height:14px;margin-top:-5px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent,#1f6feb)}.ds-slider input[type='range']:focus-visible::-webkit-slider-thumb{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#1f6feb) 40%,transparent)}.ds-slider input[type='range']::-moz-range-track{height:4px;border:0;border-radius:2px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink-3,#85878d) 30%,transparent)}.ds-slider input[type='range']::-moz-range-progress{height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--accent,#1f6feb)}.ds-slider input[type='range']::-moz-range-thumb{width:14px;height:14px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent,#1f6feb)}.ds-slider__foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-3,#85878d);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

components.name: Switch
components.description: On/off control (free tier): 28px track, paper knob, Check Green when on, accent focus ring.
components.css: .ds-switch{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font:400 12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;color:var(--ink-2,#4a4c52);cursor:pointer;user-select:none}.ds-switch input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px}.ds-switch__track{width:28px;height:16px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--line-2,#cfcbbf);position:relative;transition:background .15s}.ds-switch__track::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--panel,#fffefb);transition:transform .15s}.ds-switch input:checked+.ds-switch__track{background:var(--ok,#2f8f4e)}.ds-switch input:checked+.ds-switch__track::after{transform:translateX(12px)}.ds-switch input:focus-visible+.ds-switch__track{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#1f6feb);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Diagram key
components.description: Canvas legend listing the diagram encodings with samples drawn from the real components, so the key can never drift from the nodes.
components.html:
• 4px stripe and tinted tag: the resource's AWS category, reused in the cost rows and legend.
  • ~$1.23~ before a figure: usage-based estimate, adjustable with the sliders in Cost.
  • IAMSGIAM / SG chips: access attached to the node; click to expand the policies.
  • Dashed contour: a virtual boundary such as a router or the internet edge, not a deployed resource.
  • + addedIn a plan or comparison: pills mark what changes; a dashed contour means the resource only exists on the other side.
components.css: .ds-keylist{display:grid;gap:7px;font:12px/1.5 Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui;color:var(--ink-2,#4a4c52);background:var(--panel,#fffefb);border:1px solid var(--line,#e2dfd6);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(30 25 10/.06),0 2px 8px rgb(30 25 10/.05);padding:10px 14px 12px;max-width:430px}.ds-keylist ul{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;display:grid;gap:7px}.ds-keylist li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:86px 1fr;gap:10px;align-items:center}.ds-keylist__sample{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:20px}.ds-keylist__stripe{width:44px;height:16px;border:1px solid var(--line-2,#cfcbbf);border-left:4px solid var(--cat-storage,#2f7342);border-radius:5px;background:var(--panel,#fffefb)}

narrative.overview:
terraprev's screens are drawings, not dashboards. An engineering drawing is read by someone who will build from it, so every line is measured, every part is labeled, and nothing is drawn for effect. The interface keeps the same contract: a warm paper ground, hairline structure drawn at exactly 1px, one blue that behaves like the single ink used to mark up a drawing, and a fixed hue per AWS resource category so the same thing is always the same color. Density is high -- this is a tool an engineer checks between terminal commands -- and the tone stays quiet, because the change that just applied should be the loudest thing on the page, never the page itself.

Depth is carried almost entirely by tone and hairlines -- page shell, drafting canvas, panel -- with a single soft 'floating chrome' shadow reserved for small controls that sit on top of the drawing. Data is never blurred, glazed or layered in glass; the drawing metaphor forbids atmosphere. Everything uncertain is stated plainly: 'not priced' appears as ink, not a rounded zero.

The system is explicitly not the AWS Console (no inconsistent chrome, no buried information, no hard-saturated fills), not neon 'hacker' dark mode (no green-on-black, no glow), and never playful (no illustrations, no bouncy motion, no emoji as UI).
keyCharacteristics: Warm-paper neutrals (page #f4f2ec, canvas #f8f7f3, panel #fffefb) instead of pure white or black.
One accent blue for the entire interface; nine fixed category hues used only as small identifiers.
1px hairline borders and tonal layering carry structure; no shadows except under dropdown menus.
A single Inter type scale from 10 to 28px, tabular figures on every number, JetBrains Mono only for code and identifiers.
Small radii (3-8px); resources and boundaries drawn as flat 1px contours with no fills or shadows; change and status carried by worded tags, not color alone.
Light and dark are two prints of the same drawing: identical structure, swapped papers.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Printing Blue is the only accent. It points: selection, links, active state, live attention. It never tints a surface wider than a banner, and no second accent exists.

rules.name: The Labeled-Color Rule
rules.body: A color never carries meaning alone. Status and change states always ride with words (tags, keys, captions); the hue is a second reading of the same text.

rules.name: The Stamped-ID Rule
rules.body: Category and overlay hues are small stamps -- the outline of a type code, a dot, a bar, colored tag text. They identify; they never decorate, fill panels, or run down a card edge.

rules.name: The Tabular-Figure Rule
rules.body: Every number, money or count, is set in Inter with tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) so columns of figures line up vertically; money values right-align and keep unit prefixes distinct.

rules.name: The Mono-Boundary Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono marks machine text -- addresses, ARNs, HCL, paths, SKUs. It never sets prose, labels, or buttons.

rules.name: The Caps-Label Rule
rules.body: All-caps is a label texture, not an emphasis tool: 11px/600 with +0.06em tracking, muted ink, used for eyebrows above content -- never for sentences.

rules.name: The Negative-Track Rule
rules.body: Anything 15px and larger reads as display and gets negative tracking (-0.01em to -0.025em); small sizes keep default tracking.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Elevation appears only to mark something floating above the drawing, or responding to state (selection, fresh apply).

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: All structure is drawn with 1px hairlines (--line between sections, --line-2 around drawing elements). A shadow never does a border's job, and no border is thicker than the ink rules of the brief (2px under document h2 and table totals).

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Exactly one shadow vocabulary exists, and it belongs to dropdown menus. Toolbars, canvas controls and drawn elements stay flat with a 1px contour.

rules.name: The Category-Outline Rule
rules.body: Every diagram resource identifies its category by the 1px outline of its type code (EC2, ALB), matching the cost bar and legend dot in the same hue. No side stripes: a thick colored edge on a rounded card is the generic dashboard tell, and it breaks at the corners.

rules.name: The Dashed-Means-Virtual Rule
rules.body: A dashed contour always means "not solid": virtual (router) nodes, removed/replaced resources, or a live-attention frame. It never means decorative variety.

dos: Do keep every number in tabular figures, right-aligned where columns meet, with the quantity x price x source one mono line below (font-size 10-11px).
Do state the unknown: "not priced" as text in muted ink, never a bold $0.00, never blank.
Do use the category-outlined type code as the identity kit for any new resource kind before inventing any new color.
Do draw all structure with 1px hairlines; keep shadows to dropdown menus; strip shadows from print output.
Do keep dark mode a re-papering of the same drawing -- identical structure, hue, spacing (only papers/shadows vary).
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: pause dash animations and pulses, keep state changes readable through color and shape.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue, a gradient fill, a glow, or a glass/blur surface; one blue and paper do the work.
Don't use pure #fff or #000 surfaces or neon-on-black dark mode; every neutral stays warm.
Don't rely on color alone for added/changed/removed or severity -- words or border style always accompany it, and comparisons show gaps without red/green verdicts.
Don't scale elevation or motion as decoration; shadows don't grow on hover, and idle screens don't animate.
Don't break the 10-28px type scale or set prose/labels in mono; ad-hoc sizes and 'code-chic' text are off-system.
Don't let category hues become surfaces; they identify (outline/dot/bar/tag text), they don't fill.
